Dr. Saji D'Souza · Founder
Born from clinical practice. Built for everyday life.

Dr. Saji D'Souza

Ayurvedic Physician · Formulator
BAMS, Kerala University · MS, Rajiv Gandhi University · Founder, KSAC Hospitals

A pioneer of evidence-based Ayurveda, practising since 1998. Dr. Saji pairs classical therapy with modern diagnostic investigation, documenting outcomes through objective before-and-after medical reports. He works across spine, neuro, joint and chronic pain, and treats only where Ayurveda can make a measurable difference.
